title: Advanced Topics in Asian American Studies; Techno Orientalism
description: This course introduces students to techno-Orientalism and the ways in which Asian Americans (and Asia more broadly) have been interpreted through narratives of technology and futurity. By exploring literature, film, and art, we will consider how race, gender, science, and labor impact how Asian Americans are perceived in the future or even as technologies themselves. Asian American creative responses to techno-Orientalism will also be studied.
